title: session-load's rss_mean_mb averages each class over only the samples it was alive in, so means are not comparable across classes and arms
goal: Every rss_mean_mb row of session-load is the mean over all sampler ticks of its phase (or arm B's window), a tick with no process of the class counting as 0, so no class's mean exceeds the 'all' mean of its phase and arm

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bench_load
fake = NS(roots=[], panes=[], clone='.', pane_runs=0, started=lambda r: [])
# two sampler ticks: the pane's kbmon alive in the first only, a kb tool in the second only
sampler = NS(ticks=[{'kbmon': 700 * 1024}, {'kb-tools': 100 * 1024}], seen={})
out = bench_load.Replay.summary(fake, sampler, 1.0)['classes']
kbmon, whole = out['kbmon']['rss_mean_mb'], out['all']['rss_mean_mb']
assert abs(whole - 400) < 1e-6, ('all mean over both ticks', whole)
assert kbmon <= whole and abs(kbmon - 350) < 1e-6, ('a class mean is not over every tick of its phase (a tick without it counts 0)', kbmon, whole)

clauses.clause: Every rss_mean_mb row of session-load is the mean over all sampler ticks of its phase (or arm B's window), a tick with no process of the class counting as 0, so no class's mean exceeds the 'all' mean of its phase and arm

gates.question: When the sampler took no tick at all, what is a class's rss_mean_mb?
options: the class's own peak (the old fallback, kept)
gates.recommendation: the class's own peak (the old fallback, kept)
gates.reason: a replay too short to sample still reports the processes' own ru_maxrss rather than a false 0
gates.answer: the class's own peak (the old fallback, kept)
